purpose: Keep scientific interpretation, representation design, target realization, implementation, and review independently inspectable.

stages.authority: May interpret scientific material and state a bounded account with explicit basis, assumptions, regimes, and limits.
May define target-neutral researcher capabilities, contrasts, observables, explanatory bridges, interactions, and review probes.
May choose target-native computation, interaction, view, dependency, delivery, and verification decisions without changing scientific meaning.
May materialize and mechanically verify the accepted plan.
May judge faithfulness, discrimination, boundary awareness, and usefulness; this judgment is not inferred from mechanical success.

dependency_rules: framework must not depend on target definitions, applications, cases, or consumers
runtime may depend on framework contracts but not on a concrete consumer
target definitions may depend on runtime public contracts and framework semantics
applications and cases may depend on runtime and selected target definitions
consumers may select upstream components but must not own a second editable framework copy
generated distributions must remain untracked and non-authoritative
